items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: when Joe Helbock got back, he said he needed a singer like he needed a hole in his head.

ctx.x: The guitar player, he was a silent partner. And he was the one that heard me sing and he's the one that hired me.
And, of course, when Joe Helbock got back, he said he needed a singer like he needed a hole in his head.
So that's the reason I say, I didn't amount to very much until that article in the New Yorker came out.
